project.title: Microbial community analysis of wastewater activated sludge from pulp and paper wastewater treatment plant
project.description: The project was aimed to understand microbial composition of the wastewater activated sludge obtained from pulp and paper wastewater treatment plants during various fermentation procedures to produce polymeric inclusions
project.center_name: nstitut national de la recherche scientifique
